baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Exchange acquires renewable talk; distraction is the purchased means, and causative misdirection gives it an outbound effect on travelers.

activation_trace.role: Literal exchange makes the discourse deliberately procured rather than accidentally encountered.
Occupation by one thing supplies the attention-diversion function.
Renewed speech supplies repeatable, replenishable content.
Departure from right direction supplies the intended effect.
A traversable extended road makes the displaced object a course of movement.

changed_reading.before: A person prefers idle talk and strays.
changed_reading.after: An actor procures repeatable discourse as an instrument for rerouting others from a traversable divine way.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Talk can be bought because it offers companionship and relief from estrangement; social comfort then becomes the delivery channel of diversion.

activation_trace.role: Companionship that removes loneliness makes the human collective an affiliative medium.
Exchange turns affiliation-bearing speech into an acquired good.
Its comforting occupation displaces attention from another object.
Conversation and renewed report provide the social vehicle.

changed_reading.before: Amusement wins because it is entertaining.
changed_reading.after: Distracting talk may win by selling belonging and familiar company, so attachment can misdirect before any proposition is assessed.

baseline_models.mechanism: Road, waymark, concealment, and replacement branches turn ignorance into a navigational failure: marks are absent, obscured, or exchanged for substitutes.

activation_trace.role: The extended road supplies the navigational field.
A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing makes knowledge operational wayfinding.
Otherness and negation supply the explicit absence of such guidance.
Replacement activates the exploratory possibility that false markers are installed, not merely omitted.
Concealment supplies the mechanism by which a route can disappear from view.

changed_reading.before: The misleader acts while lacking information.
changed_reading.after: The discourse removes or replaces the marks by which a route is recognized, producing navigational loss amid abundant speech.

baseline_models.mechanism: Taking or acquiring formalizes ridicule: the pronominal object is converted into a reusable social posture rather than receiving a passing joke.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition and adoption make mockery an established use.
Ridicule supplies the adopted posture toward the object.
The path remains a live antecedent, so a course of travel itself may be captured as ridicule.

changed_reading.before: The actor also jokes about it.
changed_reading.after: The actor appropriates the referenced path or discourse as a standing ridicule-format; the pronoun's exact antecedent remains open.

baseline_models.mechanism: The actor turns direction into usable entertainment; the consequence reverses that logic by making abasement and debasing use part of what happens to the actor.

activation_trace.role: Painful punishment supplies the sanction.
Humiliation by contempt supplies its social quality.
Debasement through use activates a reversal of the actor's own instrumentalizing practice.

changed_reading.before: A humiliating punishment follows the offense.
changed_reading.after: The sanction mirrors the offense's instrumentalization: one who debases guidance into a usable diversion undergoes debasement as consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding marked, joined, and corrective book distinguishes bad discourse by its missing checks, not by speech or novelty alone.

activation_trace.role: Renewed talk supplies the discourse being tested.
Diversion identifies the failed function.
A visible sign supplies an inspectable marker absent from the diversion.
Joining parts supplies coherence across utterances.
Corrective restraint supplies governance over what discourse does.

structural_cues: 31:2 places marked, joined, wisdom-governed discourse before the purchased discourse of 31:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marks, joining, and corrective restraint; I infer a quality-control contrast, while a live alternative is simple juxtaposition of two discourse types.

changed_reading.before: New or entertaining talk is the suspect category.
changed_reading.after: The suspect category is procured talk detached from visible marks, internal joining, and corrective governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah locates the diversion in an auditory sequence: recitation arrives, the hearer turns, hearing fails to become understanding, and the ear is figured as loaded.

activation_trace.role: Competing occupation supplies attention capture.
Talk supplies content in the same channel as recitation.
One sound following another supplies the contested auditory stream.
Turning away supplies active withdrawal from the stream.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies what is blocked.
Heaviness in the ear supplies a load model for non-reception.

structural_cues: 31:7 immediately follows 31:6 and expands discourse, turning, hearing, ear-load, and punishment in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies channel competition and ear-load; I infer that acquired talk can preload attention, while arrogance remains a live independent cause of refusal.

changed_reading.before: Distracting content persuades by offering a false idea.
changed_reading.after: It can work earlier than persuasion by occupying the auditory channel until recitation is heard as sound but not received as guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supports, anchors, and sway provide a material model for waymark loss: discourse can destabilize a traveler's frame rather than merely propose a wrong destination.

activation_trace.role: The road anchors the material analogy in the focus.
Waymarks supply orientation within that road.
A support holding something up supplies cognitive bracing.
Firm settling supplies resistance to displacement.
Oscillation and leaning supply the failure state when anchoring is lost.

structural_cues: 31:10 sequences unseen supports, fixed anchors, and prevention of sway.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical stabilization; I transfer its arrow to attention and orientation, while the materially literal creation scene may remain only an analogy.

changed_reading.before: Misdirection points travelers toward a wrong route.
changed_reading.after: Misdirection can first remove cognitive bracing and induce oscillation, making any stable route difficult to hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Luqman's spoken warning is a counterexample to condemning discourse as such: renewed speech can soften and reorient when its function is admonition rather than occupation.

activation_trace.role: Talk and report supply the neutral medium.
Displacement supplies the harmful function, not an intrinsic property of speech.
Articulated speech supplies a beneficial use of the same medium.
Heart-softening fearful reminder supplies its reorienting function.

structural_cues: 31:13 embeds direct father-to-son speech whose purpose is warning and reorientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beneficial spoken counsel; I infer a functional contrast with distracting talk, while genre or speaker authority could also explain the difference.

changed_reading.before: The focus warns against a class of entertaining speech.
changed_reading.after: The focus tests speech by what it does to attention and direction: talk can either occupy away from the path or recall a hearer to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A no-knowledge demand may be resisted despite intense social pressure, while companionship is retained and another path is followed; misdirection is therefore not equivalent to disobedience or social rupture.

activation_trace.role: Known disclosure anchors the focus's epistemic deficit.
A traversable way anchors the directional question.
Pressure driven to the limit supplies coercive force.
Absence of disclosed knowledge marks the pressured claim as unauthoritative.
Refused compliance separates direction from mere obedience.
Following trace after trace supplies evidence-responsive movement.
The explicitly followed path supplies the positive alternative.

structural_cues: 31:15 combines refusal, continued good companionship, and selective path-following in one instruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercion without knowledge and discriminating followership; I infer that 31:6 condemns engineered direction, not principled refusal, while family duty remains a separate constraint.

changed_reading.before: Leaving a socially presented course is itself evidence of misguidance.
changed_reading.after: Direction must be tested: one may refuse a coercive, knowledge-free command yet preserve relationship and follow an evidenced path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated human and no-knowledge frame is expanded into entangled disputation lacking three checks: disclosed knowledge, gentle direction, and illuminating joined text.

activation_trace.role: Renewed talk supplies the discourse form awaiting diagnosis.
The repeated human collective marks a structurally parallel actor class.
Twisted contest supplies the discourse operation.
Missing disclosed knowledge repeats the focus deficit.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies a second absent check.
Ordered writing supplies a third absent check.
Illumination specifies what the written check should make visible.

structural_cues: 31:20 repeats the sequence 'among people ... concerning God ... without knowledge' and then adds neither guidance nor illuminating book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax plus the three deficits; I infer that 31:20 exposes a mechanism active in 31:6, while it could instead be a neighboring case of the same broader failure.

changed_reading.before: Purchased entertainment distracts from a religious path.
changed_reading.after: The purchased product can be a tightly wound argumentative discourse system whose persuasive activity outruns knowledge, direction, and inspectable textual light.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purchase and adoption are rival attachment acts to firm holding: the focus asks not only what one believes, but what acquired object can actually bear weight.

activation_trace.role: Exchange supplies acquisition of one attachment object.
Adoption supplies the actor's chosen hold on mockery.
Holding and retaining supply the competing hand-action.
Resting trust in the dependable supplies the load-bearing criterion.

structural_cues: 31:22 root ع ر و at word 10 has no branch inventory and is used only as the packet's structural handhold cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, adoption, holding, and dependability; I infer a contrast of attachment affordances, while the hand imagery may remain rhetorical rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: The buyer chooses the wrong content.
changed_reading.after: The buyer chooses an attachment that cannot bear consequence, whereas the alternative is an orientation one can securely hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Small immediate enjoyment and later compulsion combine with shimmering deception: the purchase succeeds by making near benefit salient while hiding its non-substitutable cost.

activation_trace.role: Exchange supplies the horizon-sensitive choice.
Enjoyable play supplies the near payoff.
Punishment supplies the delayed cost.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the temporary return.
Smallness limits that return.
Compulsion supplies the later loss of choice.
A gleam that does not hold supplies deceptive salience.
Life as benefit supplies the surface on which that salience operates.

structural_cues: 31:24 orders brief enjoyment before compelled punishment.
31:33 repeats the warning against being deceived by worldly life and the deceiver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies short benefit, compulsion, and unstable gleam; I infer temporal mispricing in the purchase, while the two warnings may also stand independently.

changed_reading.before: The buyer gets entertainment and later receives punishment.
changed_reading.after: The product is attractive because it prices a small gleaming benefit now while occluding a future cost that the buyer cannot trade away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pens, replenishing ink, non-exhaustion, and intelligible words relocate the contrast from content versus content to two supply systems: commodified novelty and inexhaustible meaningful address.

activation_trace.role: Purchase makes one discourse stream a commodity.
Renewed report supplies its novelty cycle.
A prepared writing implement supplies production capacity.
Ink feeding a pen supplies replenishment.
Failure to be exhausted denies scarcity to the contrasted words.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies meaningful address.

structural_cues: 31:27 imagines an immense writing supply and denies that God's words would run out.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two discourse economies; I infer a supply contrast with 31:6, while inexhaustibility may concern divine magnitude rather than media competition.

changed_reading.before: One set of words is idle and another set is true.
changed_reading.after: A finite market repeatedly manufactures novelty to capture attention, while meaningful divine address is pictured as exceeding every material writing supply.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overwhelming danger strips mixed layers, produces momentary undivided allegiance, then permits knowing denial to return; crisis acts as an ablation test on acquired distraction.

activation_trace.role: An occupying layer supplies what crisis may displace.
A covering laid over something supplies overwhelming conditions.
Intermingled turbulence supplies the stressor.
Purity after mixture supplies temporary removal of competing allegiance.
Obedience and submission identify what becomes undivided.
Escape by separation supplies release from the stressor.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the post-crisis relapse.

structural_cues: 31:32 sequences covering danger, sincere invocation, rescue, moderation, and knowing denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixture, purification, rescue, and relapse; I infer a stress test that temporarily removes distraction, while fear alone could explain the changed behavior.

changed_reading.after: It can operate as a recoverable surface layer over acknowledged dependence: crisis removes it briefly, and safety allows the layer to be rebuilt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing limits on knowing tomorrow, acquisition, and place of death turn 'without knowledge' into overconfident commerce in outcomes no human possesses.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower anchors the claimed deficit.
The road anchors uncertainty as practical direction.
Purchase anchors the economic claim to possession.
Repeated knowledge language supplies an explicit epistemic boundary.
Knowing by inquiry supplies what no self can achieve about the stated futures.
Seeking and obtaining benefit connects unknown tomorrow to acquisition.
Tomorrow supplies the unavailable horizon.
Loss of life supplies the terminal outcome whose location is unknown.

structural_cues: 31:34 closes the surah by repeating knowledge while denying each self knowledge of tomorrow's gain and place of death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded knowledge beside acquisition and future outcome; I infer that purchased discourse falsely performs possession of the unknown, while the closing list can remain a general epistemic boundary.

changed_reading.before: The buyer or misleader happens not to know enough.
changed_reading.after: The offense includes packaging confidence and direction as a purchasable possession precisely where tomorrow's return and endpoint exceed human knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the mill-feed branch is concrete and form-distant; valid because it attaches directly to purchased لهو beside ever-renewed talk and gains a later ink-supply echo; render only as a process analogy, not a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Procurement supplies deliberate intake.
Grain thrown into a mill supplies the feedstock image.
Something newly occurring supplies repeated fresh units.
Ink feeding a pen reinforces a replenished production process.

changed_reading.before: Idle talk is consumed as a finished item.
changed_reading.after: Purchased novelty is continually fed into an attention mill, making distraction a production process rather than a single message.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because restraint or weaning is a distant branch beside the ordinary punishment branch; valid because it is anchored in عذاب after chosen pleasure and reinforced by brief enjoyment; render as secondary reversal, never as the primary sense of punishment.

activation_trace.role: Play and enjoyment supply the chosen attachment.
Restraint and weaning supply forced separation from that attachment.
Humiliation supplies the degrading manner of separation.
Temporary enjoyed benefit reinforces the before-and-after reversal.

changed_reading.after: As a secondary resonance, punishment forcibly weans the actor from the diversion that had been chosen as a substitute good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the road-direction image comes from the non-dominant split mapping of د ر ي; valid because 31:34 explicitly denies knowing, while 31:6 joins way, waymark, and no-knowledge; render as a qualified route metaphor, not morphology of the surface verb.

activation_trace.role: A traversable road supplies the focus anchor.
A distinguishing waymark supplies navigational knowledge.
Knowledge and inquiry supply the explicit denied capacity.
Road direction, wind-course, and alignment activate the split-root route image.
Tomorrow supplies the road segment unavailable in advance.

changed_reading.before: The discourse lacks facts about the path.
changed_reading.after: It offers false directional confidence about a tomorrow whose very road-alignment is unavailable to the traveler.

strongest_changes: Purchased talk became an attention-and-navigation instrument rather than mere amusement.
31:20 recoded it as entangled argument lacking knowledge, guidance, and illuminating joined text.
31:7 located causal action in auditory loading before propositional persuasion.
31:15 and 31:34 bounded the model: evidence-based refusal is not misdirection, and future route and return are not human possessions.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings and material branches kept social comfort, waymark replacement, attention feed, degrading use, forced weaning, and the unknown-road reading live without merging them.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of the feminine pronoun in وَيَتَّخِذَهَا remains structurally open in this focus-only reconstruction.
The stabilization, mill-feed, and split-root road mechanisms are abductive transfers and require explicit qualification.
The focus grammar strongly supplies purpose, but the relative shares of deliberate public influence and self-rerouting remain uncertain.
